name: Zirconium pentatelluride
equilibrium_context: Dirac semimetal at the boundary point between strong and weak topological insulator, bulk gap below 30 meV; centrosymmetric in equilibrium
summary: Carries the strongest non-thermality evidence in the entire register - and at the same time the entry with the largest open interpretational risk.

driven_states.emergent_property: THz-driven coherence of the A1g Raman mode at 1.2 THz drives the system above a field threshold into a long-lived metastable phase. The DFT assignment reads: strong topological insulator to weak topological insulator, with an intervening Dirac semimetal phase at the critical atomic displacement.
driven_states.source: Vaswani, Wang, Mudiyanselage et al., Phys. Rev. X 10, 021013 (2020), doi:10.1103/PhysRevX.10.021013
driven_states.caveat: Argued explicitly as non-thermal - non-thermal spectral shape, mode-selective coupling, no effect under optical pumping at the same deposited energy. This is the strongest non-thermality evidence in the register. However: the topological assignment is made exclusively via DFT at a prescribed atomic displacement, not through a measurement of an invariant. ZrTe5 is notoriously sample-dependent, which limits transferability.

threshold.quantity: field threshold for the formation of the metastable phase

driven_states.measured_quantity: THz differential transmission, coherent phonon emission spectra

driven_states.emergent_property: Laser-induced coherent B1u phonons dynamically break the inversion symmetry and generate two pairs of Weyl points. Their chirality manifests itself in a transverse, helicity-dependent photocurrent perpendicular to the symmetry-breaking axis, with a ballistic transport length of about ten micrometers.
driven_states.source: Luo, Cheng, Song et al., Nature Materials 20, 329 (2021), doi:10.1038/s41563-020-00882-4
driven_states.caveat: A borderline case of state versus response, and the entry with the largest open risk. The measured observable is a nonlinear photocurrent, that is a response, but it is interpreted as the signature of a symmetry-broken Weyl state existing during the phonon coherence. The attribute dissipationless rests on a derived ballistic length, not on a conductivity measurement. ZrTe5 is known for a strong photothermoelectric photocurrent channel at contacts; an independent replication is missing. Important pump parameters cannot be substantiated from the accessible version.
driven_states.measured_quantity: emitted THz transient as a measure of the nonlinear photocurrent

sources: Vaswani et al., Phys. Rev. X 10, 021013 (2020), doi:10.1103/PhysRevX.10.021013
gaps: Topology inferred in both cases, not established by a measurement of an invariant.
Pump parameters of the Weyl entry cannot be substantiated and have therefore been left empty.

provenance.notes: Literature search and field extraction by AI agents under the direction of D. Leonforte; every numerical value and citation checked against the cited work and every DOI verified. Not reviewed by a domain expert. Corrections are welcome and are the intended path to improvement.
